created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the RBAC Role was created.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Name of the RBAC Role. For a built-in role, this is Anthropic's name for the access that the role grants. Anthropic may change this name, so to keep a lasting reference to a role, store its `id`.

source.description: Whether the RBAC Role is built-in or custom. More values of `type` may be added, so do not treat every role that is not `built_in` as `custom`.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Object type.

For RBAC Roles, this is always `"rbac_role"`.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the RBAC Role was last updated.
